name: sea-lion-sounds
description: Make VS Code sound like a sea lion colony. Play custom sounds while typing and when terminal commands succeed or fail.

seaLionSounds.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable Sea Lion Sounds. When off, the colony goes quiet and no sounds are played at all.

seaLionSounds.masterVolume.markdownDescription: Master volume for all Sea Lion Sounds, from `0` (silent) to `1` (loudest). Every individual sound volume is multiplied by this value.

seaLionSounds.typing.enabled.markdownDescription: Play a sound while typing in the editor.

seaLionSounds.typing.volume.markdownDescription: Volume of the typing sound, from `0` to `1`. Multiplied by `#seaLionSounds.masterVolume#`.

seaLionSounds.typing.cooldownMs.markdownDescription: Minimum delay between typing sounds in milliseconds. Lower values bark more often while typing fast; `60` keeps up with most typists.

seaLionSounds.typing.sound.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a custom `.mp3` or `.wav` file for the typing sound. Leave empty to use the bundled sound.

seaLionSounds.typing.maxChangedCharacter.markdownDescription: Skip the typing sound when a single document change inserts or removes more characters than this. Stops large pastes, formatters and refactors from triggering a sound.

seaLionSounds.terminal.enabled.markdownDescription: Play sounds when integrated terminal commands finish. Requires [shell integration](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/terminal/shell-integration) to be active.

seaLionSounds.terminal.volume.markdownDescription: Volume of the terminal success and failure sounds, from `0` to `1`. Multiplied by `#seaLionSounds.masterVolume#`.

seaLionSounds.terminal.successSound.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a custom `.mp3` or `.wav` file played when a terminal command exits with code `0`. Leave empty to use the bundled sound.

seaLionSounds.terminal.failureSound.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a custom `.mp3` or `.wav` file played when a terminal command exits with a non-zero code. Leave empty to use the bundled sound.

seaLionSounds.terminal.unknownExitCode.markdownDescription: What to play when the shell reports no exit code. This happens when you press Enter on an empty prompt or cancel a command with `Ctrl+C`.

seaLionSounds.statusBar.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the Sea Lion Sounds toggle in the status bar.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
